condition_B: four byte-exact repetitions of A; not 80,000 unique queries
first_occurrence: pre-registered warmup, recorded and analyzed both included and excluded
fixed_index_scope: one build per process, all repeated ef batches on that same index
window_comparison_limit: A and B use different independently built indexes; window, cache, build, order and temperature may be confounded
statistics: per-index sample CV (n-1) by ef, with and without first warmup; across-index CV of per-index medians; no threshold changes or selected best samples
elapsed_limit: Rust JSON supplies QPS and latency, not raw elapsed seconds; elapsed in review.json is derived as query_count / QPS
telemetry_limit: one-second total CPU includes benchmark; Job CPU/I/O cumulative; stdout arrival times approximate batch-end markers and may be buffered
sensor_limit: optional raw ACPI zones may be unavailable/uncalibrated; frequency/clock counters may not reflect instantaneous core frequency; missing readings are recorded, not guessed
observer_limit: wall duration includes intentional CPU sampling wait; observer process CPU delta includes all Python threads, not just the monitor
failure_policy: stop on first validation, integrity, supervision, or timeout; retain all partial records; optional sensor unavailability is recorded; no retry or cherry-picking
